datasets.name: UAV imagery of Zhangmu Port area
datasets.verbatim: We collected the image data of the Zhangmu Port area with the UAV platform.

datasets.name: Places365 dataset
datasets.verbatim: The Places365 dataset is a scene image dataset published by MIT.

datasets.name: UC Merced land use dataset
datasets.verbatim: The UC Merced dataset includes 21 types of land use images. The data were selected from the aerial remote sensing images of different cities from the United States Geological Survey.

datasets.name: RSSCN7 dataset
datasets.verbatim: The RSSCN7 dataset is a remote sensing image dataset released by Wuhan University in 2015.

methods.name: feature-based transfer learning algorithm
methods.summary: A transfer learning approach that uses pre-trained CNN models (fine-tuned on source domain datasets like Places365, UC Merced, and RSSCN7) to extract features from UAV imagery, which are then fed into an SVM classifier for landslide detection.
methods.verbatim: Therefore, we proposed a feature-based transfer learning algorithm.

availability.author_statement: The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and UAV imagery are not linked or provided, and the custom feature-based transfer learning algorithm code is not available.
